en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of an Alpine town in a valley, surrounded by high, partly snow‑covered mountains. In the center stands a tall church with a slender bell tower and pointed spire. To the right, on a rocky hill, is a prominent square tower and castle complex overlooking the town. Dense traditional buildings fill the foreground. Along the very top edge, faint reversed handwriting is visible, likely part of a caption.
